context: CommentBox renders user-submitted comments. Comment bodies may contain rich text formatting from the editor.
explanation: Removing the DOMPurify sanitize() call before dangerouslySetInnerHTML injects raw user HTML into the page — any <script>, onerror handler, or event attribute in a comment executes as XSS in every viewer's browser. Fix: always sanitize untrusted HTML through DOMPurify (or similar) before passing it to dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
